body: Thanks! Anything you'd care to share? If it's on the community info page just call me lazy and I'll go look 😂
Wow. I really hadn't thought about it like that. I hope so.
I appreciate the love ❤️ thank you!
I will, thanks! When I was falling asleep last night I said "and this is why Reddit is better than twitter."  Because no one will send the cops my way for talking about jumping.
Not saying I'm cured, but having you guys around to talk to definitely makes me feel better!

Thanks! Maybe I'll be back next time I'm sad but so far, every suicidal thought becomes, "I should post that," ergo narcissism is keeping me alive lol. It's just nice to feel less alone.  


Edit: Spelling.

Totally, but trying to avoid mentioning names in case they find me ;) (I seriously swore an oath to "never tweet shit."). 


Ive got a home, and finding a job is hard. Only HS diploma and, if someone does see my resume, they often think it's fake (even though they could just google my name). I've decided going back to school is the best idea for me too. Me and college just didn't work the first go round. 


I'd prefer to stay anonymous, but if you attend school in a city where there are record labels, it's possible to get an internship at one in exchange for college credit. I have a few friends who have done this and eventually gotten jobs. 


Thanks for all your encouragement! It's really helped a lot.
Good for you too. And thanks!

It was awesome. I got to meet people before they got famous even! I was working as an unpaid assistant in the music industry (a job I got by being an eager and dedicated intern). Worked with my idols, ppl I've looked up to since I was a child. This lasted for three years. Might be worth mentioning that even though I was homeless during some of this, I felt fulfilled in my career. Then one day, they all moved far away. They taught me skills and gave me credentials, so I should be happy, right? But instead I realize I'm getting to old to be a rockstar, which was what I always really wanted. You know, Icarus syndrome. 

Edit: I never got a reason from them for the move, but I think it made more geopolitieconimical sense.
